rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: The eight House, and those Questions properly belonging unto it
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The preceding chapter is followed by an ornamental divider introducing the eighth-house section.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Separate prefatory text, not a predictive outcome; boundary below Chapter LXVI.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Of Death, Dowry, Substance of the Wife, &c.
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The section title enumerates death, dowry and property-related eighth-house subject matter.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: The wife's-property body belongs to later Chapter LXVIII, not current chapter.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Chap. LXVII. If the absent party be alive or dead?
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The first numbered eighth-house chapter asks about the presumed life status of an absent person.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Historical text only, not a method for determining actual missing-person status.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: what relation querent hath to party enquired of
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly says judgment depends on the relationship of querent to absent party.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Do not assume one planet or one house means the same thing for all relatives.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Friend, Wife, Father, Child, or Servant
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Friend, spouse, parent, child and servant are listed as different question contexts.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original house derivation requires separately identifying the queried relation.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: first house and his Lord significator of querent
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: First house and its ruler are reserved for the person asking.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Do not misassign the absent party to the querent's ascendant by default.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: party quesited Sign of house and Lord thereof and Moon
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The absent person receives the relevant derived house sign, its ruler and the Moon.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: The Moon's role is a supplementary significator; context matters.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Lord of his ascendant in fourth or eighth from own ascendant
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly presents a fourth/eighth-house placement of absent person's ruler as one death testimony.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: The passage explicitly needs prolonged absence, remote parts and strong corroborating intelligence.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: long absent, remote parts, strong intelligence concurring
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author limits the initial fatal implication to long absence and allegedly corroborating information.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: The sentence crosses original PDF438-439; house position alone is NOT his complete evidence.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Lord of his ascendant or Moon in twelfth from own house with evil Planet
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The absent person's ruler or Moon in the derived twelfth alongside an unfavorable planet is named.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original requires relative-house derivation and interaction with an ill planet.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: in twelfth square or opposition unfortunate Planet
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A harsh aspect in the derived twelfth is given as another fatal testimony.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Keep square and opposition distinct from neutral twelfth placement.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Sun unfortunate or afflicted; Moon in like manner
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: An afflicted Sun or similarly afflicted Moon is cited in the death assertions.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No independent medical, missing-person, or outcome data; no diagnostic inference.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: for then the absent is dead
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author gives a death conclusion after the listed twelfth-house/affliction testimonies.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Period astrological claim, not real evidence of death.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator in sixth from own house or sixth of Question
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: An absent-party significator in sixth house is used to discuss possible illness.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Sixth from own derived house is not necessarily sixth from the main chart.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: in square or opposition Lord of sixth without Reception
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Square or opposition involving sixth-house ruler without reception is another illness premise.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Missing reception is an explicit qualifier; do not treat all hard aspects identically.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: or benevolent aspect of a Fortune
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A favorable aspect of a benefic modifies the illness interpretation.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original phrasing allows a benefic modifier, not unconditional rescue.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: the absent is then sick
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Under the specified sixth-house/affliction conditions Lilly proposes illness.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Unverified historical inference only.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: if going unto, not separated from aspect
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Applying rather than separating affliction is interpreted as illness yet to develop.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Direction of aspect cannot be flattened to mere contact.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: hath not been, but will be suddenly ill
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author forecasts sudden future sickness if the adverse aspect is applying.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Unverified medical prediction, no actual patient case.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: going from conjunction of evil Planets
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Separation from a harmful conjunction is treated differently from application.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Both bodily conjunction and aspects are present in original alternatives.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: departing from Combustion
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Emergence from combustion is offered as a further alternative of escaping danger.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original does not require conjunction and combustion simultaneously.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: lately escaped danger, sickness or peril
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly interprets separating conditions as a recent escape from misfortune.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Cannot be used to infer anyone's actual health history.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: disaster greatness by signs, aspect and afflicting house
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: He proposes considering the sign, aspect and originating house for severity.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No calibrated severity scale; flexible post-hoc interpretation.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator in sixth but not joyned Lord sixth or Infortune
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly warns that a sixth-house occupant alone is not enough to conclude serious illness.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Exclude conjunction with sixth lord and other afflicted planets for this alternative.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: amicable aspect Fortune or strong in Signe
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Good aspects or planetary strength are specified reasons not to judge illness.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: This counterexample prevents a universal sixth-house-illness rule.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: weary or drowsie; lately let blood, taken Physick
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: He suggests tiredness, sleepiness, recent bloodletting or precautionary medicine instead.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Historical healing practices are descriptive only, not medical recommendations.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator strong separated Fortune and in good house
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly calls strong, favorable-house placement and separation from benefic evidence of survival.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Separation from a fortune is distinct from separation from a malefic.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: absent lives
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author asserts the person lives under the above source conditions.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Never independently confirms an absent person's real status.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: lately square or opposition of Infortunes
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Earlier adverse square/opposition is described as distress without necessarily fatal result.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Past affliction differs from currently applying affliction.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: perplexed or suffered much misery
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: He gives difficulty and suffering as possible interpretations of the past aspect.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Person-level mental or physical suffering unverified.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: not dead unlesse Lord of eighth together in mischance
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly explicitly withholds death judgment unless eighth-house ruler adds affliction.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: This strict qualification contradicts simple 'bad aspect = dead' classifications.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Whether one absent will return or not, and when?
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A separate unnumbered question begins immediately after the source's survival discussion.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Heading begins in the bottom margin PDF439 and body opens PDF440; belongs to LXVII.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: consider by what house party signified and what Planet
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The absent person's assigned house and significator are required before evaluating return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: House selection is relative to the relationship specified earlier.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator first house though Journey long
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A significator in the first is listed among claimed safe-return positions.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original specifies a voyage even across seas may be involved.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator ninth long Journey beyond Seas
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Ninth-house position is associated with long overseas journeys.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Meaning is travel scale, not unbounded guarantee of survival.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator twelfth very long Journey
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Twelfth-house placement is related to very long travel.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Distinct from the earlier derived-twelfth adverse affliction branch.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator fifth moderate Journey
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Fifth house is tied to an intermediate journey.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Authorial classification, not measured distances.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator third short Journey
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Third house signifies comparatively short travel.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: This is the original's distance-specific assignment.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: commit disposition Planet in any of these houses
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Dispositive connections to planets placed in travel houses are included.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Disposition language may be interpreted differently by later astrological schools.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: absent not die in Voyage but return
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly predicts eventual return under the listed travel-house and disposition alternatives.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: This is an unsupported historical forecast, not a reliable missing-person inference.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator in seventh will return, not in hast
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Seventh-house placement is associated with delayed rather than immediate return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original specifically says not quickly.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: at country first went, only now thinks returning
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: He conjectures that the traveler had not previously considered coming home.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Unverified third-party thought/intent inference.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator fourth stay longer than seventh
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Fourth-house position predicts even longer absence than seventh.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Comparative clause essential; do not collapse both into generic return.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: third or ninth aspect Planet in ascendant
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: An aspect between a travel-house significator and an ascendant planet suggests plans to return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original allows third OR ninth and does not name a single aspect type.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: preparing to come home and fully resolved
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly infers the traveler has resolved to return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Intent cannot be read reliably from astrological positions.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: second in aspect with Planet ninth
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Second-house placement with aspect to a ninth-house planet is a separate route.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Do not fuse with third/ninth ascendant branch.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: providing money for voyage homewards
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly conjectures that funds are being assembled for homeward travel.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Unverified economic/intention report.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: nor will it be long ere home
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: He predicts not much time before return in the second/ninth configuration.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No operational calendar scale supplied here.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: cadent not behold own ascendant
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A cadent significator that does not aspect its ascendant is treated as lack of return intent.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: The source permits both unwillingness and inability in the same sentence.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: neither cares nor thinks return, cannot if would
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly conjectures the person neither wishes nor can return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: This is unvalidated claim about third-party mental state.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: cadent and afflicted, not behold ascendant
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: An afflicted cadent significator is the stronger unfavorable version.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Distinct from merely cadent without other affliction.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: no hopes return, never come
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: He forecasts no return under the additional impediments.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No independent case supports a permanent conclusion.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator Retrograde or Moon joined Retrograde Planet and behold ascendant
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Retrogradation with an ascendant aspect is described as indicating an unexpected reversal toward home.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Keep alternative significator-retrograde versus Moon joined to retrograde planet.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: sudden return when not expected
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author predicts a surprise return under the retrograde condition.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Direction/strength of original aspect requires contextual interpretation.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: find his Significator impedited, see afflicting house lord
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly instructs readers to classify obstacles by the house ruled by the afflicting planet.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: The afflictor's rulership is a precondition, not the person's own house.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Lord fourth afflictor: detained without liberty
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Fourth-house afflictor is associated with being detained.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Historical symbolic assertion, not evidence of detention.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Lord sixth afflictor: ill
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Sixth-house afflictor is associated with illness.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Not diagnostic, nor proof of absence due to illness.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Lord eighth afflictor: fears dying journey
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Eighth-house afflictor is associated with fear of dying before returning.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original says FEARS dying, not necessarily that death happened.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Lord twelfth afflictor: prisoner cannot procure liberty
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Twelfth-house afflictor is tied to being imprisoned.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No criminal or detention diagnosis from this text.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: these configurations impede return
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author summarizes the various causes as obstacles to travel home.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No independent probability or event validation.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Having considered absent, now have recourse to Moon
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The return discussion shifts from the absent person's significator to the Moon as general indicator.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Sentence starts at the end of original PDF440 and continues on PDF441.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Moon conjunction or good aspect absent Significator
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: An aspect of the Moon to the absent person's significator supports a possible return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original allows bodily joining, beneficial aspect, or disposition transfer.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: or commit her disposition to him
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Disposition transfer to the absent significator is an alternative supportive condition.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Keep transfer distinct from a direct conjunction.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: absent Significator posited ascendant
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The favorable lunar connection is said to be stronger when the person's significator is placed at the ascendant.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Do not score lunar aspect alone as an unconditional arrival.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: it argues his return
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author interprets the conditions as indicating return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Not verified by any observed missing-person outcome.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: nearer aspect degree ascendant sooner return
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The distance of a lunar aspect from the rising degree supposedly governs rapidity of return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No numeric time mapping; the text is comparative.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Significator only in eighth, no other impediment
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly says eighth-house placement by itself prolongs return but does not prevent it.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Explicit absence of other impediment is required.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: at last he will come
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author predicts eventual return from un-afflicted eighth-house placement.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Contrast with the immediately following adverse case.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: unfortunate in eighth
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Affliction while in eighth is treated as a stronger bad indication.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Do not equate bare eighth placement with eighth affliction.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: he dyes and never returns
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly concludes permanent nonreturn/death under adverse eighth-house affliction.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Unsupported death prediction; never apply to an actual missing person.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Moon separating fourth seventh ninth or third Lord
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The Moon is described leaving a house-lord associated with a travel setting.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original lists four alternatives; no one rule covers all.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: or any Planet under earth then joined ascendant Lord
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A Moon moving from an under-the-earth planet to the ascendant lord is another path.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Preserve aspect chronology: separation then new application.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: or Planet above earth
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The Moon's application to a planet above the horizon is also listed.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Relationship to prior alternatives somewhat ambiguous.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: absent will returne
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author concludes the person will come back under those lunar progressions.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Historical belief only, with multiple underspecified alternate premises.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: The time when he will returne
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: An unnumbered subsection shifts to the timing of absence and eventual return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Still within Chapter LXVII, not a new numbered chapter.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: first length Journey
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Before deriving time, Lilly says to judge how long the journey takes.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Pre-chart external travel duration affects the judgment.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Lord ascendant and Significator absent
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The derived timing compares the questioner's first lord and the absent party's ruler.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Keep party roles and which lord is meant explicit.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: superiour Planets and long/short journey
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: He says planetary speed/class and length of route matter.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: This is qualitative; no fixed unit or deterministic mapping.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: voyage by water or land
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Mode of travel is an independent factor in choosing a time unit.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Real-world journey knowledge is source-internal reliance, not chart-only prediction.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: both Significators applying sextile or trine
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: An approaching favorable aspect between two significators supplies a prospective event date.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Original says sextile or trine, not every contact.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: observe Ephemeris day of aspect
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly says the aspect's date can be read from an ephemeris.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Printed seventeenth-century astronomy not independently checked here.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: near that day hear news or have letter
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The predicted outcome here is receiving news or correspondence, not physical return.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Keep news and person-arrival endpoints separate.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: supposes party so near possibility
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The tight event-day forecast presupposes a nearby traveler.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Long distances explicitly weaken the exact-day interpretation.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: very far, fortnight or more from aspect
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: If the traveler is far away, correspondence can arrive two weeks or more after aspect date.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: This flexibility precludes simple pre-specified accuracy windows.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: when come home or querent see him
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The source distinguishes actual reunion from hearing news.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Do not count received letter as a proven reunion.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: both Significators conjunction
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A future conjunction of the two significators is named as a probable reunion indicator.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: A conjunction is a different criterion from the earlier sextile/trine news rule.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Querent shall be in his company
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly claims the parties will be together when that conjunction takes place.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: An unverified person-level outcome.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: absent Significator preceding one own houses
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Another method counts the remaining degrees before the significator enters its own sign or house.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: The author's 'own houses' signification needs source-native dignity semantics.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: degrees put to days, weeks, months, years
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Degree gaps are converted to time units, chosen contextually.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No reproducible unit selection from degrees alone.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: movable Signes short stay
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Cardinal or movable signs are associated with brief duration.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Time scaling is qualitative rather than calibrated.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: common signs more long; fixed prolong
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Mutable/common and fixed signs are used to lengthen the estimate.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Keep intermediate common-sign and long fixed-sign alternatives.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Of the death of the Querent, or space of his own life
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A new unnumbered subsection shifts from absent-person return to lifespan inquiry.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Heading is at top PDF442; source order follows PDF441 return section.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: fearfull of death feels ill, asks may live year two three more
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The author describes a person asking whether they will survive some number of years.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Period discussion, not valid medical mortality prediction.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: ascendant, Lord and Moon for his Significators
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The questioner receives first house, ascendant lord and Moon as significators.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Different from the absent person's derived house earlier.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: houses essential dignities applications and planets associated
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: Lilly asks to inspect placements, dignity and planetary relations.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: No numeric disease-risk model or medical assessment.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: first Lord joyned Fortune, commits virtue to well dignified
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: A fortunate connection of first lord to a dignified benefic is treated as protective.
rules.original_scope_exception_uncertainty: Reception/disposition transfer and absence of later contacts are separate conditions.

rules.short_editorial_anchor_not_full_transcri: Fortune not Lord eighth
rules.historical_author_assertion_paraphrase: The favorable conclusion requires the receiving fortune not to rule the eighth house.
